get.summary: Retrieve uptime and downtime incidents for a project
get.description: Returns the uptime rate over a time window and the downtime incidents recorded in it. The rate is computed from confirmed incidents only, never from raw ping samples: a single failed ping can be a hosting provider blocking our monitoring IPs, so it takes a multi-region confirmation before anything counts against uptime. A project whose monitoring is off or paused returns monitoring_enabled false and a null rate rather than a fabricated 100. The window defaults to the last 30 days and cannot exceed 366 days. Incidents are truncated to limit, most recent first; incidents_total reports how many the window holds, and the rate always covers the whole window regardless of that truncation. An incident carries the region that observed it, lowercased (eu_west, us_east, us_west, asia_hk, australia), and description is a machine-readable reason such as dns_resolution_failed. Neither is a closed set: treat an unknown value as opaque.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 30 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now, cannot be in the future.

example.message: "to" must be greater than "ref:from"

post.description: Updates one or more themes on a project and returns a process ID to track the work. Themes are identified by their stylesheet, the value returned as the theme key by GET /projects/{projectId}/themes. A theme already on its latest version, or one whose updates were excluded from the dashboard, is skipped; if none of the requested themes has an available update, the call returns 404 rather than an empty process. Repeating an identical call within a few minutes returns duplicate true instead of queueing the same work twice.

theme_keys.description: Stylesheets of the themes to update

clear_cache.description: Whether to clear the site cache once the update is done

example.message: "theme_keys" is required

404.description: No theme with an available update matches the request

example.message: No theme with an available update matches theme_keys

get.summary: Retrieve the maintenance reports of a project
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the maintenance reports of a project, most recently generated first. Reports generated for support purposes and previews sent from the report editor are excluded.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing token, invalid scope, or the project does not exist or is not accessible

example.message: You are not authorized to access this resource.

post.description:
Generates a maintenance report covering the requested period, using the report template linked to the project, then emails it to its recipients.

Generation and sending both run in the background: the response acknowledges the request with a report in the `PENDING` state, and `GET /projects/{projectId}/reports/{reportId}` tells when it reaches `FINISHED` or `ERROR`.

The period cannot exceed 366 days, which is what a yearly report needs. The number of reports a project can generate in a day is capped, and going over it answers `429`.

start_date.description: First day of the reported period, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: Last day of the reported period, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

emails.description: Recipients of the report. When omitted, the recipients configured on the report template are used.

400.description: Invalid parameters, or the project has no report recipient

example.message: This project has no report recipient. Pass emails in the request body, or configure recipients on the report template.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing token, invalid scope, or the project does not exist or is not accessible

example.message: You are not authorized to access this resource.

404.description: No report template is linked to this project

example.message: No report template is linked to this project

429.description: Too many reports have been generated for this project today

example.message: Too many reports have been generated for this project today

get.description:
Retrieves a single maintenance report of a project, with the delivery status of each of its recipients.

When the report has a PDF, `pdf_url` is a download link that expires 15 minutes after the call, so it has to be fetched server-side and cannot be handed over to an end client as a permanent link.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing token, invalid scope, or the project does not exist or is not accessible

example.message: You are not authorized to access this resource.

404.description: The report does not exist or does not belong to this project

example.message: Report not found

get.summary: Download the shared login blocklist Bloom filter
get.description: Returns the shared login guard blocklist as a binary Bloom filter blob. The response is identical for every project and is safe to cache at the edge. The body is raw application/octet-stream (UBLM wire format), not the JSON envelope.

get.summary: Retrieve PHP errors detected on a project
get.description: Returns a paginated list of the PHP errors, warnings and notices recorded on a project, with how many times each one fired and when it was last seen. Each entry is a deduplicated signature, not a single occurrence. Errors reported by the WP Umbrella plugin itself are excluded.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Keep only fatal errors, or only warnings and notices

parameters.name: source_slug
parameters.description: Comma-separated plugin or theme slugs to filter on

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search the error message, the source name or the file path

data.message: Uncaught Error: Call to a member function get() on null

example.message: "severity" must be one of [FATAL, MINOR]

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the custom works of a project, most recent execution date first.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing token, invalid scope, or the project does not exist or is not accessible

example.message: You are not authorized to access this resource.

post.summary: Create a custom work for a project
post.description: Creates a new custom work entry for a specific project. Supports one-time and recurring works.

execution_date.description: Execution date of the custom work

estimated_time.description: Estimated time of the custom work

is_recurring.description: Whether the custom work is recurring

frequency.description: Frequency value, required when is_recurring is true

type_frequency.description: Day of the week for weekly works or quarter start for quarterly works, required for those frequencies and ignored for monthly works

specific_day.description: Day of the month for monthly works, required for that frequency and ignored for the others

put.description: Updates a custom work of a project. This is a full replacement, not a partial update: every optional field omitted from the body is reset, so send the complete resource even for a one-field change. Setting is_recurring to true creates or updates its schedule, setting it to false deactivates the schedule without deleting past occurrences.

execution_date.description: Execution date of the custom work

estimated_time.description: Estimated time of the custom work

is_recurring.description: Whether the custom work is recurring

frequency.description: Frequency value, required when is_recurring is true

type_frequency.description: Day of the week for weekly works or quarter start for quarterly works, required for those frequencies and ignored for monthly works

specific_day.description: Day of the month for monthly works, required for that frequency and ignored for the others
